reason: Test-signal quality batch (#605 soundness rules, #612 canary-cassandra vacuous-test detection, #477 promotion gate): module-size to 30176. newViolations is 0 and the pre-existing violation count is unchanged at 21 -- nothing was absorbed here to avoid a fix. Five complexity/length/nesting findings that the first cut DID introduce were fixed rather than allowed: scanVacuity was split into readSource/resolveTargets/annotationFor/scanAllBlocks, scanBlock into tautologies/targetNeverInvoked/absenceOnly, promotionVerdict into lintOrAbstain/groupIntoAxes/decide/remedyFor, and importedTargets into pythonImportedTargets/jsImportedTargets. Only the aggregate remains. ATTRIBUTION, measured against origin/main at 968fc65 rather than derived: ts/src/core/vacuity-scanner.ts is new at 736 lines, ts/src/core/promotion-verdict.ts is new at 385, and the four modified source files grew a net +524 (static-linter.ts 528->871, cli-commands.ts 1062->1197, cli.ts 333->357, pattern-matcher.ts 283->305) -- 1645 source lines accounted for, against 1542 of headroom consumed above the allowed ceiling (the difference is comment-only lines, which this metric weighs differently from code). Unlike #686's allowance the isolation could not be done empirically by moving files aside: both new modules are imported by cli-commands.ts, so removing them fails the build rather than producing a comparable measurement. WHY THE SIZE IS EARNED rather than absorbable: the two new modules are detectors, and roughly a third of each is comment that records a defect the code encodes. That is deliberate and it is the expensive half to lose. Six of those comments exist because the rule was WRONG until a measurement moved it -- VAC-003's first cut reported 254 findings on this repo's own 2154 tests and nearly all were correct negative tests, so the rule now requires that no assertion observes the target; SOUND-001's taint pass excludes temp-dir sources because it was 0-for-3 actionable through them; the target inference had to learn destructured bindings and declarator-less destructuring assignments because doc-links.test.ts read as touching nothing; and blankStrings had to learn template literals because 16 of 33 findings on this repo were the linter reading its own fixtures. A reader who deletes those comments will re-introduce the versions that were measured wrong. Nor would splitting help: module-size is a repo-wide aggregate, so N files summing to the same lines score identically, and both new files sit well under the per-file thresholds (736 and 385). SIZE IS ALSO NOT THE WHOLE COST PICTURE: these modules replace no existing code and add two CLI commands (vacuity-check, promote-check) plus three rows in ts/test/gate-conformance.test.ts, so the growth buys detection this repo demonstrably lacked -- three vacuous tests shipped in one cycle (#486) past coverage, review-test and CI, and all three are statically detectable now. HAZARD, per the note on fix-686-doc-link-checker.json: the recorded value is ABSOLUTE, so any allowance merged to main after this branch was cut silently invalidates it and check-arch will read a fresh regression. Re-measure and update this number rather than reading the arrow in a verdict as a delta (#689). REBASE RE-MEASUREMENT (the hazard above, realised): this allowance recorded 30176 against origin/main at 968fc65. #712 (personas, #462/#341) then merged, and at e66264e the same tree measures 31229 -- so the recorded absolute no longer covered it and check-arch read a fresh 4264 regression against the stale baselines.json value of 26965. Re-measured on the rebased tree rather than adding the difference: this branch own contribution is unchanged, only the base moved. This is the third time in one session that an absolute allowance invalidated on rebase (#689, tracked in #703).
